text:
Kaito N: Hey everyone, Kaito here  joining remotely from Tokyo today! Super excited to get started on Platform. Quick list of first-day asks: 1) who issues Okta invites for APAC? 2) where do I request the dev laptop image (I'm remote) and shipping? 3) any timezone-friendly pairing buddies for late-afternoon PST / morning JST? Also two quick fun facts: I can't swim, and I once ate 12 takoyaki in one sitting. Ask me later which is the lie.

Maya D: Welcome Kaito! :wave: I'll help with Okta and infra access. For APAC invites we sometimes need to route through security-ops due to regional settings  I'll start the request. DM me your preferred phone for MFA if it's different from your Okta email.

Ibrahim S: Hi Kaito  if remote, file an IT ticket at https://support.redwood.ai/new-laptop and choose "remote shipping" + "developer image". Expect 5-10 business days for international shipping. If you need a loaner quicker, let me know and we can arrange the cloud dev image in the meantime.

devex-bot: Welcome Kaito! Your onboarding checklist has been created: https://onboard.redwood.ai/2127770000. Steps: accept Okta invite, request laptop, add SSH key, join #platform. Reply with "okta done" or "laptop done" to auto-update.

Kaito N: Thanks Maya/Ibrahim  my phone is +81-90-1234-5678 for MFA. Also curious: timezone pairing  I'm JST (UTC+9) and happy to do overlap around 16:00 PST (09:00 JST) if anyone can.

Lina H: Hey Kaito, Lina from Platform  I often run a 30-min sync at 16:30 PST for infra handoffs, that works great for you? Also, we have an "APAC-friendly dev pairing" rota  I'll add you.

Maya D: 16:30 PST overlaps well with me too. I'll put a recurring 1:1 on our calendars for the first two weeks.

Ibrahim S: For SSH keys we prefer ed25519. Example to add key to GitHub: `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | curl -u <username> -H "Content-Type: text/plain" --data-binary @- https://api.github.com/user/keys` (or just add via the GitHub UI).

Kaito N: Good to know re: ed25519. One last silly thing  two truths and a lie answer: I can't swim is the lie  I can actually float like a rock but can't dive :sweat_smile: Thanks for the warm welcome  will accept the Okta invite and file the laptop ticket now. Looking forward to the infra sync and ramen recommendations later. :ramen:

devex-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: Okta invite accepted. Remaining: request laptop, add SSH key.

Maya D: Cheers Kaito  ping here when the ticket number is in and we'll fast-track if needed. Also, welcome gift: I'll ship a sticker + hoodie pack once your address is on the ticket.

Kaito N: Ticket submitted (SUP-3917). Thanks everyone!
